{{Upcoming|the 26.3 port|type=page}}
A '''cushion''' is a decorative item that comes in the 16 dye colors. Cushions were added in ''Minecraft'' 26.3; see {{MCW|Cushion}} for how they behave. They are not in [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.4|1.12.4]], which is for 26.2; this page describes the pack's 26.3 port, released as the 1.12.3 alpha for 26.3. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds a [[stonecutter]] recipe for every color, so wool can be cut straight into cushions.

== Obtaining ==
=== Stonecutting ===
One block of wool of a color gives 2 cushions of the same color in the [[stonecutter]]. For example, a black wool gives 2 black cushions.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/stonecutting/black_cushion.json|at=c8c13d7c0f57052846353ba8b0986896e9c95c4c}}</ref> There is one recipe per color.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/stonecutting/white_cushion.json|at=c8c13d7c0f57052846353ba8b0986896e9c95c4c}}</ref>

=== Crafting ===
The vanilla recipes still work: three slabs of one color of wool in a row make a cushion, and a cushion and a dye of another color make a cushion of that color. The wool slabs come from the stonecutter as well: see [[Stonecutter]].

=== Chest loot ===
[[White Cushion|White cushions]] are found in the barrels of [[abandoned camp]]s, 1–2 at a time.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/barrels/abandoned_camp_barrel.json|at=c8c13d7c0f57052846353ba8b0986896e9c95c4c}}</ref>
